article.headline: Jerome leads Memphis against Golden State after 45-point game
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (1-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (0-1, 11th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Jerome leads Memphis against Golden State after 45-point game
article.linkText: Jerome leads Memphis against Golden State after 45-point game
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (1-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (0-1, 11th in the Western Conference) San Francisco; Friday, 10 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Memphis faces the Golden State Warriors after Ty Jerome scored 45 points in the Grizzlies' 123-103 win against the Utah Jazz. Golden State finished 37-45 overall and 24-28 in Western Conference games last season. The Warriors averaged 114.6 points per game while allowing opponents to score 115.2 last season. Memphis went 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies averaged 114.7 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.7 last season. INJURIES: Warriors: Brandin Podziemski: out (back), Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Charles Bassey: out (patellar), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee), Stephen Curry: day to day (ankle). Grizzlies: Isaiah Stewart: out (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
